name: Zhou Yutong
bio:
Zhou Yu Tong, born in Huainan City of Anhui Province, China on September 21, 1994, is an actor and graduate of the Shanghai Institute of Visual Art Performance Department 2012. In 2013, she made her acting debut in the film "Balala the Fairies: The Magic Trial" (巴啦啦小魔仙大电影).

She has won 2019 Fashion Artist of the Year by Sina Fashion Awards and 2019 Fashion Figure of the Year by the iFeng Fashion Choice Awards.
